product.name: Cotton percale sheet, queen
product.description: What you notice is wet linen, and cotton percale is the main thing in the pack, batch river pail eighty.

blocks.text: Sunday evening at a wash house was for hand hemming, and the slip reads amber nook forty nine.
The wash crew held it two nights so the cloth softens faster, batch clay drawer sixty two.
Wash the sheet cold and skip a hot dryer the first time, which is the right habit for a queen bed, batch iron bin twenty three.
It rested the next morning at the cutting table, then went into a cotton sack, batch birch hook thirty six.

presentation.review_line: Read the lines, then pay if they still fit.

modal.name: Wick trim
modal.text: Wick trim is $6.20 and stays out unless you add it.
